notes.title: Patch 3.1.4
notes.content:
A merry February to all!

Welcome to [i]Paradise Inc[/i] version 3.1.4!   This patch addresses a few edge cases that our players have reported to us in the last year.... and typos.  [i]Always[/i] more typos.

The three bugs patched are:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Samantha that caused the intruder storyline to never progress.  This was already fixed on our Itch.io and webpage versions, but now it's fixed in Steam as well.
[*] Casino odds should now calculate correctly to reflect Nadia's help, should she be 'employed' there.
[*] It is now possible to pay Avery back double during the ending even if you have already successfully paid off his initial debt when impressing him.
[/list]

We've also had a request to make a Mac version of the game, which we're looking into.  If you're a Mac user, feel free to chime in to add your voice!

notes.title: Patch 3.1.3
notes.content:
Hello hello, demonic denizens!

Right on the heels of the weekend, we've pushed out another small patch.  This one only affects Steam users.  Read on and enjoy!


[h3]The Tweak[/h3]

We've made a small change to the code that enables Steam to unlock achievements that you already have from previously saved games.

Let's say that you used to play our game on Itch.io, before we launched on Steam, and you have a saved game there with 20 achievements.  You buy the Steam version, you import your saved game.... and you still have your [i]in-game[/i] achievements, but the Steam achievements would still be locked!  

As of [u]this[/u] patch (3.1.3), if you import a saved game (whether an old Steam save or an Itch.io save or whatever), Steam will detect what achievements are present in that save and unlock the matching achievements in the Steam version of [i]Paradise Inc[/i].   This should make our completionists [u]very[/u] happy (and there's a surprising amount of you, we've found)!

[h3]The Antivirus[/h3]

Apparently some antivirus programs (looking at you, Avast), think that ParadiseInc.exe might be a virus.  It's not, we swear!  This isn't an uncommon thing with Electron-based games (just Google 'electron game antivirus false positive' for a few pages of it).  If you tell it it's fine once, it should quit complaining afterwards.

[h3]The Bugfix[/h3]

We're not sure exactly what this is, and so far we've only had one confirmed report.  It's not an issue with the GAME as far as we can tell.  But, in case you run into it, here's how we fixed it.

[b]The Symptom:[/b]  [i]Paradise Inc.[/i] just refuses to update.  

Even though the published version is 3.1.3, your version stays on 3.0 or 3.1, and no matter how you beg, plead, and threaten, it stubbornly refuses to  update itself.  You've uninstalled it and reinstalled it, you've tried verifying the local files, and.... nothing.  It just doesn't update no matter what you do.

[b]Possible Fix #1:[/b]  [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/6AD7-820D-8BE5-E51F]Clear your Steam download cache.[/url]  This seems to help if [i]Paradise[/i] refuses to recognize that there IS an update available, and never downloads the update.  

[b]Possible Fix #2:[/b]  If the update [i]downloads[/i] but the in-game version never updates, you might have a corrupted installation.  Go look in your [i]Paradise Inc.[/i] Steam folder (for example, [i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Paradise Inc\resources\app[/i]), and see if there's an [i]index.html[/i] file in there.  If not, that's the problem.

The fix is to [url=https://sinspirational.com/paradise/]go our website[/url], download the index.html file there (just right-click and choose 'Save As'), and put it where it's supposed to be.

Again, we've only had one report of this, but Luciana works in IT and insists that it's [i]never[/i] 'just one bug'.


Happy hunting!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 3.1.2!
notes.content:
Happy soon-to-be-February!

We're coming at you live today with a small patch to address a typo (of course), a bug (of course), and Luciana being a little [u]too[/u] evil (...of course!)

[list]
[*] 'Huge Tracts of Land' is now spelled correctly.
[*] Squished an infinite energy bug if you exploited Jolie's Housewife form for free, uh, 'work'.
[*] Made a certain hidden achievement less evil.  Check the patch notes in the game for details, since there's spoilers there.
[/list]

A big shoutout to ADHD & Vex from our community Discord for alerting us to the infinite energy bug (ADHD) and being the first confirmed person to find that particular hidden achievement (and helping convince Luciana to alter it)!

notes.title: Happy Holidays & an Official Walkthrough To All
notes.content:
Merry Christmas, Happy Hanukkah, a glorious Sol Invictus, and similar holiday wishes.  We've a small bit of happy news to share.

We launched Paradise Inc. on Steam back in mid-December, and on Christmas Eve we passed our milestone goal for Steam sales.  Honestly we were skeptical people on Steam would be interested in our labor of love -- one million words is a lot of reading! -- and this far surpasses what we'd hoped for.  Not only did we make it, we made it in one month!  We owe this all to our fans who have supported us and encouraged us over the years.  A wonderful holiday gift from [i]you[/i] to [i]us[/i]!

We've been working hard on an official walkthrough for the last few weeks, and we're happy to announce we managed to get it done in time for Christmas. It gives some tips on mechanics, maximizing your energy, defeating some of the puzzles, and how to get some of the achievements. It is not a 100% exhaustive guide to everything, but it's pretty close!

[url=https://sinspirational.com/paradise/walkthrough.html]https://sinspirational.com/paradise/walkthrough.html [/url]

See you next year!

- Cambion and Luciana

notes.title: Patch 3.1
notes.content:
Good morning demonic denizens!

Now that our coder Luciana is back from vacation, we've fixed a few things that came up since launch.

[list]
[*] By request, we've added a Font Size setting.  Now you can scale text up and down to make all that reading a little easier.
[*] Minor refinements to the 'light' theme.
[*] A few bug-fixes to the end game that would occasionally cause problems in rare cases.
[*] Fixed an issue where Jolie's hucow / cowgirl transformation would trigger the in-game achievement, but not the related Steam achievement.
[/list]

If you find anything else, please let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/nkdDuemu24]our Discord[/url] or via our [url=https://bsky.app/profile/sinspirational.bsky.social]BlueSky account[/url]!  

We've posted a small update as well over on our Patreon regarding our holiday and post-holiday plans.  For those who want the [u]very[/u] short version:  our Patreon is paused, we won't be thinking about future projects until after the New Year, and Cambion is working on a walkthrough that several of you have requested!

Happy holidays, and see you next year!

- Luciana and Cambion
